info.title: Polymarket WebSocket API
info.description:
Real-time WebSocket streaming API for Polymarket prediction-market data.

## Connection
Connect to `wss://api.struct.to/ws` using a standard WebSocket client.

## Authentication
An API key is required. Pass it via **header** or **query parameter**:

**Header (recommended):**
```
X-Api-Key: <your-api-key>
```

**Query parameter (browser / frontend):**
```
wss://api.struct.to/ws?api_key=<your-api-key>
```

The query parameter is only used when no `X-Api-Key` header is present.

## Joining a room
After connecting, send:
```json
{"type":"join_room","payload":{"room_id":"polymarket_trades"}}
```

## Subscribing
After joining, send a `room_message` with room-specific subscribe payload:
```json
{
"type": "room_message",
"payload": {
"room_id": "polymarket_trades",
"message": {"action":"subscribe","condition_ids":["0xabc…"]}
}
}
```

## Keepalive
Send `{"type":"ping"}` periodically to keep your connection alive. The server responds with `{"type":"pong"}`. Connections that have not sent a `ping` within **60 seconds** are closed.

polymarket_trades.title: Trades
polymarket_trades.description:
Real-time stream of matched Polymarket prediction-market trades. At least one filter is required — open-ended subscriptions are rejected to prevent fan-out across all trades.

**Filters (at least one required):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (with or without `0x` prefix)
- `market_slugs` — market slugs
- `event_slugs` — event slugs (delivers all markets under each event)
- `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"` to clear all subscriptions.

polymarket_asset_prices.title: Asset Prices
polymarket_asset_prices.description:
Real-time crypto-asset price feed (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, …). Delivers both raw `asset_price_tick` events on every price update and `asset_price_window_update` events at candle open/close boundaries.

**Filter (optional):** `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols to filter by. Empty array subscribes to all symbols.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_asset_window_updates.title: Asset Window Updates
polymarket_asset_window_updates.description:
Filtered stream of asset-price candle open/close events. Unlike `polymarket_asset_prices`, this room **requires** at least one filter so clients receive only the symbols and/or timeframes they care about.

**Filters (at least one required):**
- `asset_symbols` — uppercase symbols (e.g. `"BTC"`, `"ETH"`)
- `timeframes` — candle sizes: `"5m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"4h"`, `"1d"` / `"24h"`

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_market_metrics.title: Market Metrics
polymarket_market_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics per market condition, aggregated across multiple timeframes (`1m`, `5m`, `30m`, `1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `7d`, `30d`). One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs. Invalid or malformed IDs are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_event_metrics.title: Event Metrics
polymarket_event_metrics.description:
Real-time volume and transaction-count metrics aggregated at the event (parent market group) level, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `event_slugs` — event slugs (lowercase).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_position_metrics.title: Position Metrics
polymarket_position_metrics.description:
Real-time volume, trade-count, and OHLC price/probability metrics per outcome-token position, across multiple timeframes. One event is pushed per timeframe window on each update.

**Filter (required):** `position_ids` — ERC-1155 token IDs (decimal or hex; normalized to decimal strings internally).

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_pnl.title: Trader PnL
polymarket_trader_pnl.description:
Real-time profit-and-loss updates for tracked traders, delivered at global, market (condition), and event granularity.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_global_pnl_update`, `trader_market_pnl_update`, `trader_event_pnl_update`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_trader_positions.title: Trader Positions
polymarket_trader_positions.description:
Real-time position updates for tracked traders. Streams full position snapshots whenever a position PnL changes in the database.

**Filter (required):** `traders` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Events pushed:** `trader_position_update` — includes PnL fields, shares balance, market slug, outcome, and all enriched data.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_accounts.title: Accounts
polymarket_accounts.description:
Real-time balance updates for Polymarket wallet accounts.

Always streams ERC-1155 outcome token (shares) balance changes for subscribed wallets as `accounts_update` events. Opt in to additional token streams via boolean flags:
- `include_usdce: true` — also receive `usdce_update` events (USDCe collateral balance)
- `include_matic: true` — also receive `matic_update` events (MATIC gas balance)

**Filter (required):** `wallets` — EVM wallet addresses. Invalid addresses are returned in `rejected`.

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_order_book.title: Order Book
polymarket_order_book.description:
Real-time CLOB orderbook snapshots for Polymarket outcome tokens. Each event contains the full aggregated bid/ask book plus pre-computed derived metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, USD liquidity depth, level counts).

**Filters (at least one required, max 500 combined):**
- `condition_ids` — 64-char hex condition IDs (market); delivers snapshots for all positions in that market
- `position_ids` — hex token/asset IDs (individual outcome tokens)

**Unsubscribe:** Send `action: "unsubscribe_all"`.

polymarket_wallet_tracking.title: Wallet Tracking
polymarket_wallet_tracking.description:
Real-time trade alerts for tracked Polymarket wallets. Streams a `wallet_tracking_alert` event whenever a subscribed wallet executes a trade, enriched with market metadata (slug, question, outcome, image).

**Filter (required):** `wallet_addresses` — EVM wallet addresses to track.

**Unsubscribe:** Disconnect or re-subscribe with a new address list.

WalletTrackingAlertEvent.description: Server-pushed event: a trade executed by a tracked wallet. Envelope type: "wallet_tracking_alert".

usd_amount.description: USD value of the trade (decimal string, 6dp)

metadata.description: Market metadata — null when enrichment is unavailable

PredictionMarketMetadata.description: Market metadata enrichment attached to wallet tracking alerts

OrderBookUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: full CLOB orderbook snapshot for an outcome token. Envelope type: "order_book_update". Delivered whenever the book changes for a subscribed condition or position.

bids.description: Bid levels sorted best-first (highest price first)

asks.description: Ask levels sorted best-first (lowest price first)

hash.description: Orderbook content hash — identical hash means no change

bid_liquidity_usd.description: Total USD value of all bid levels

ask_liquidity_usd.description: Total USD value of all ask levels

MaticUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: MATIC native balance change for a wallet. Envelope type: "matic_update". Only delivered when `include_matic: true`.

token_address.description: Native token address — omitted when not available

balance.description: Current MATIC balance (decimal string) — omitted when not available

TradesStreamSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the trades stream. At least one filter field must be non-empty.

condition_ids.description: 64-char hex condition IDs (with or without 0x prefix)

event_slugs.description: Event slugs — subscribes to all markets under each event

position_ids.description: ERC-1155 outcome token IDs (decimal or hex strings)

TradesStreamSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a trades stream subscription

rejected.description: Filter values that were rejected (invalid format)

AssetPricesSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the asset prices stream. Empty asset_symbols = all assets.

asset_symbols.description: Uppercase asset symbols (e.g. "BTC", "ETH"). Empty = subscribe to all.

AssetPricesSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an asset prices subscription

asset_symbols.description: Accepted symbols. Empty array means subscribed to all symbols.

AssetWindowUpdatesSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the asset window updates stream. At least one of asset_symbols or timeframes must be non-empty.

timeframes.description: Candle sizes to filter by. "1d" and "24h" are treated as equivalent.

AssetWindowUpdatesSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an asset window updates subscription

error.description: Set if the subscription was rejected (e.g. no filters provided)

MarketMetricsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the market metrics stream. condition_ids is required and must be non-empty.

condition_ids.description: 64-char hex condition IDs (with or without 0x prefix)

MarketMetricsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a market metrics subscription

rejected.description: Condition IDs that were rejected (invalid format)

error.description: Set if the entire subscription was rejected

EventMetricsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the event metrics stream. event_slugs is required and must be non-empty.

EventMetricsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an event metrics subscription

PositionMetricsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the position metrics stream. position_ids is required and must be non-empty.

position_ids.description: ERC-1155 outcome token IDs (decimal or hex strings)

PositionMetricsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a position metrics subscription

TraderPnlSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the trader PnL stream. traders is required and must be non-empty.

TraderPnlSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a trader PnL subscription

TraderPositionsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the trader positions stream. traders is required and must be non-empty.

TraderPositionsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for a trader positions subscription

AccountsSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the accounts stream. `wallets` is required. Share balance updates (`accounts_update`) are always delivered. Set `include_usdce` or `include_matic` to also receive those balance streams.

include_usdce.description: Also stream USDCe collateral balance updates for subscribed wallets

include_matic.description: Also stream MATIC gas balance updates for subscribed wallets

AccountsSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an accounts subscription

OrderBookSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to the order book stream. At least one filter is required. Maximum 500 combined condition_ids + position_ids per client. No `type` field is needed — the server routes by room_id.

condition_ids.description: Condition IDs (markets). All positions within each market are delivered.

position_ids.description: Token / asset IDs (individual outcome positions, hex strings).

OrderBookSubscribeResponse.description: Server acknowledgement for an order book subscription. Envelope type: "order_book_stream_subscribe_response".

rejected.description: Filter values that were rejected (invalid format or limit exceeded)

WalletTrackingSubscribeMessage.description: Subscribe to wallet trade alerts. wallet_addresses is required.

TradeStreamEvent.description: Server-pushed event: a matched trade on a subscribed market/position/event/slug. Envelope type: "trade_stream_update".

usd_amount.description: USD value of the trade (decimal string)

AssetPriceTickEvent.description: Server-pushed event: a crypto-asset price tick. Envelope type: "asset_price_tick".

AssetPriceWindowUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: candle open or close for a crypto asset. Envelope type: "asset_price_window_update". Delivered from both `polymarket_asset_prices` and `polymarket_asset_window_updates` rooms.

AssetWindowUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event from the polymarket_asset_window_updates room. Same payload as AssetPriceWindowUpdateEvent. Envelope type: "asset_price_window_update".

MarketMetricsEvent.description: Server-pushed event: metrics update for one timeframe of a condition. Envelope type: "market_metrics_update". One event is emitted per timeframe window on each update.

usd_volume.description: USD volume in this timeframe window (decimal string)

historical_confirmed_at.description: Earliest trade timestamp in window (Unix seconds)

latest_confirmed_at.description: Latest trade timestamp in window (Unix seconds)

EventMetricsEvent.description: Server-pushed event: aggregated metrics update for one timeframe of an event. Envelope type: "event_metrics_update". One event is emitted per timeframe window on each update.

usd_volume.description: USD volume in this timeframe window (decimal string)

PositionMetricsEvent.description: Server-pushed event: metrics update for one timeframe of an outcome token. Envelope type: "position_metrics_update". One event is emitted per timeframe window on each update.

TraderGlobalPnlEvent.description: Server-pushed event: global (portfolio-level) PnL update for a trader. Envelope type: "trader_global_pnl_update".

realized_pnl_usd.description: Total realized PnL in USD (decimal string)

TraderMarketPnlEvent.description: Server-pushed event: per-market PnL update for a trader. Envelope type: "trader_market_pnl_update".

buy_usd.description: Total buy volume in USD (decimal string)

TraderEventPnlEvent.description: Server-pushed event: per-event PnL update for a trader. Envelope type: "trader_event_pnl_update".

TraderPositionUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: full position snapshot for a tracked trader. Envelope type: "trader_position_update". Pushed whenever a position's PnL changes in the database.

won.description: True if this outcome resolved as winner

realized_pnl_pct.description: Realized PnL as a percentage of cost basis

AccountsUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: ERC-1155 outcome token balance change for a wallet. Envelope type: "accounts_update".

condition_id.description: Condition ID — omitted when not available

event_slug.description: Event slug — omitted when not available

UsdceUpdateEvent.description: Server-pushed event: USDCe collateral balance change for a wallet. Envelope type: "usdce_update". Only delivered when `include_usdce: true`.

token_address.description: USDCe contract address — omitted when not available

balance.description: Current USDCe balance (decimal string) — omitted when not available
